notes: Backdrops are 760x420 phase variants (day1_7/dawn/dusk/night) consumed by HoldfastInteriorView via BackdropArt; props are 128x128 RGBA with baked contact shadows consumed by HoldfastInteriorView.BuildBackground at fixed anchors; room pictograms are 128x128 RGBA consumed by RoomHotspotView.UpdateIcon at 0.5 scale above each room badge (room id truth: Assets/StreamingAssets/Data/shelter_rooms.json); tiles are 128x128 RGB, seam-safe, with no runtime consumer yet. Regeneration: backdrops+3 props via blender --background --python scripts/tools/bake-shelter-stage.py -- --only backdrops,props --phases all, then python3 scripts/tools/post-shelter-bake.py; room pictograms+2 props via blender --background --python scripts/tools/bake-shelter-rooms.py, then python3 scripts/tools/post-shelter-rooms-bake.py (also generates the tiles). Verify with each post script's --check. Regenerating placeholders via generate-shelter-placeholders.py would overwrite ALL final art — do not re-run it.
